summaries.zh: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness: keep MCP servers (streamable HTTP or stdio) in the DSH settings page, paste Postman-style headers for auth, run a connectivity test, and enable/disable each tool so disabled ones are never exposed to the model. Servers are managed from a single settings panel with one-click import from JSON; state is stored atomically in `~/.dsh/dsh-mcp-tools/state.json` (documented as credential-equivalent, since headers may hold API keys).
